title: DevBench: A Realistic, Developer-Informed Benchmark for Code Generation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of models from the same family as the synthetic data generator (GPT-4o) against non-GPT models to ensure the benchmark does not exhibit systematic stylistic bias that unfairly favors the generator's architecture.

Evaluating and comparing model performance (using Pass@1, similarity metrics, and LLM-judge scores) across six different programming languages to identify disparities and fairness considerations in language representation.
